MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.title: Exusiai
MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.description:
A Rhodes Island sniper Operator.
[gold]Exusiai[/gold] never hesitates when the guns start singing.
MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.goldMonologue: [sine]All these gems... I could turn some into ammo.[/sine]
MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.eventDeathPrevention: Still got ammo... I am not dropping here...
MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.aromaPrinciple: [sine]...This smell reminds me of Rhodes Island.[/sine]
MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.cardsModifierDescript: Exusiai's cards can now appear in rewards and shops.
MYFIRSTMOD-EXUSIAI.unlockText: Complete a run with [pink]{Prerequisite}[/pink] to unlock this character.
